Source: STDI-0002-2 v2021.1, Appendix F: XML_DATA_CONTENT DES v1.0
Name: XML_DATA_CONTENT DES
Description: The ability to place XML-formatted data/metadata within NSIF/NITF files is a needed function within the Geospatial-Intelligence community. The NSIF and NITF standards allow for inclusion of additional data types via a data structure known as the DES This field contains properties specific to the XML DATA CONTENT data extension segment (DES).

DESVER.Name: Data Definition Version
DESVER.Description: This field contains the version number of the Tag.

DECLAS.Name: Data Extension File Security Classification
DECLAS.Description: This field contains the classification level of the DES.

DESCLSY.Name: DES Security Classification System
DESCLSY.Description: The classification system used for this DES.

DESCODE.Name: DES Codewords
DESCODE.Description: This field contains codewords used for XML DES.

DESCTLH.Name: DES Control and Handling
DESCTLH.Description: This field contains control and handling information for XML DES.

DESREL.Name: DES Release
DESREL.Description: This field contains releasing instructions for XML DES.

DESDCTP.Name: Declassification Type
DESDCTP.Description: This field contains declassification type information for XML DES.

DESDCDT.Name: Declassification Date
DESDCDT.Description: This field contains declassification date for XML DES.

DESDCXM.Name: DES Declassification Exemption
DESDCXM.Description: This field contains declassification exemption info for XML DES.

DESDG.Name: DES Downgrade
DESDG.Description: This field contains downgrade info for XML DES.

DESDGDT.Name: DES Downgrade Date
DESDGDT.Description: This field contains the downgrade date for XML DES.

DESCLTX.Name: DES Classification Text
DESCLTX.Description: This field contains classification text for the XML DES.

DESCATP.Name: DES Classification Authority Type
DESCATP.Description: This field contains classification authority type info for XML DES.

DESCAUT.Name: DES Classification Authority
DESCAUT.Description: This field contains classification authority info for XML DES.

DESCRSN.Name: DES Classification Reason
DESCRSN.Description: This field contains the classification reason for the XML DES.

DESSRDT.Name: DES Security Source Date
DESSRDT.Description: This field contains the security source date for the XML DES.

DESCTLN.Name: DES Security Control Number
DESCTLN.Description: This field contains the security control number for the XML DES.

DESSHL.Name: DES User-defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: This field contains the number of bytes in the field DESSHF.

Values.0000: User-defined subheader field is not in use.
Values.0283: User-defined subheader fields DESCRC through DESSHTN included.
Values.0773: Complete inclusion of all user-defined subheader subfields

DESCRC.Name: Cyclic redundancy Check
DESCRC.Description: This field contains the calculated CRC value for the content of the DESDATA field.

DESSHFT.Name: XML File Type
DESSHFT.Description: The data in this field represents the XML file type (e.g. XSD, XML, DTD, XSL, and XSLT).

DESSHDT.Name: Date and Time
DESSHDT.Description: This field contains the time (UTC)(Zulu) of the XML file's origination in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

DESSHRP.Name: Responsible Party - Organization Identifier
DESSHRP.Description: This field contains the identification of the organization responsible for the content of the XML DES.

DESSHSI.Name: Specification Identifier
DESSHSI.Description: This field contains the name of the specification used for the XML data content.

DESSHSV.Name: Specification Version
DESSHSV.Description: This field contains the version or edition of the specification.

DESSHSD.Name: Specification Date
DESSHSD.Description: This field contains the version or edition date for the specification used for the XML DES.

DESSHTN.Name: Target Namespace
DESSHTN.Description: This field contains the identification of the target namespace, if any, designated within the XML data content (e.g. http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema.

DESSHLPG.Name: Location - Polygon
DESSHLPG.Description: This field contains a five-point boundary enclosing the area applicable to the DES, expressed as the closed set of coordinates of the polygon (last point replicates the first point).

DESSHLPT.Name: Location - Point
DESSHLPT.Description: This field contains a single geographic point applicable to the XML DES.

DESSHLI.Name: Location - Identifier
DESSHLI.Description: This field contains the identifier used to represent a geographic area.

DESSHLIN.Name: Location Identifier Namespace URI
DESSHLIN.Description: This field contains the URI for the namespace where the location identifier is described (e.g. https://nsgreg.nga.mil/genc/discovery).

DESSHABS.Name: XML DATA DES Abstract
DESSHABS.Description: This field contains a brief narrative summary of the content in the XML DES.

DESDATA.Name: User-defined data field
DESDATA.Description: This field shall contain the XML data.  The length of this field shall not cause any other NSIF/NITF field length limits to be exceeded.
